text.p: A class action suit was filed Thursday in the United States District Court for the Middle District of Florida, on behalf of purchasers of the common stock of Riscorp Inc, between February 28, 1996, and November 14, 1996, lawyers for the plaintiffs said.
The complaint charges Riscorp with misrepresenting and/or omitting material information concerning the company's operations, financial condition, and business prospects.

Plaintiffs seek to recover damages on behalf of class members and are represented by the law firms of Wolf Haldenstein Adler Freeman & Herz LLP, Bernstein Liebhard & Lifshitz, Savett Frutkin Podell & Ryan P.C. and Burt & Pucillo.
No one from Riscorp was available to comment.
